display.purpose: App title on Home, with cyan glow.

display-sigil.purpose: App title beside the 40px reticle inside a room.

target-name.purpose: Decrypted target name; sets the redaction bar height.

headline.purpose: Screen headings such as Host panel.

panel-title.purpose: Names a panel that has no larger heading.

tagline.purpose: The single red line under the Home title.

signal.purpose: The 'or' divider and the toggle's Open/Close state.

body-large.purpose: Input text and the host-board sentence.

body-small.purpose: Helper text, notes, errors, link buttons, definition values.

label.purpose: Field labels, definition terms, roster group headings.

shadows.name: primary-lift
shadows.purpose: Under the primary button only; removed when disabled.

shadows.name: reticle-glow
shadows.purpose: Home reticle; dropped at sigil size.

motion.name: ease-lock
motion.purpose: Bracket close-in (220ms), reticle snap (260ms) and masthead resize (300ms).

motion.name: decrypt
motion.purpose: Left-to-right character scramble of the target name; skipped under reduced motion.

motion.name: drain
motion.purpose: Cyan drain bar across the reveal window; skipped under reduced motion.

components.css: .ds-panel{--bg:#070b14;--surface:#0d1424;--raised:#121b2e;--ink:#e6edf3;--muted:#8a98aa;--line:#1f2a3d;--cyan:#00e5ff;--cyan-hi:#6ff2ff;--on-cyan:#070b14;--red:#ff2e63;--field-line:#2f6f86;position:relative;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:2px;padding:24px;color:var(--ink);font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif} .ds-panel::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-1px;pointer-events:none;--b:linear-gradient(var(--cyan),var(--cyan));background:var(--b) top left/16px 2px,var(--b) top left/2px 16px,var(--b) top right/16px 2px,var(--b) top right/2px 16px,var(--b) bottom left/16px 2px,var(--b) bottom left/2px 16px,var(--b) bottom right/16px 2px,var(--b) bottom right/2px 16px;background-repeat:no-repeat} .ds-panel-text{margin:0}

components.name: Target Reveal
components.description: Signature: hold to lock on; brackets close, reticle snaps, name decrypts, 5s cyan drain. Hover shows the locked state here.
components.css: .ds-reveal{--bg:#070b14;--surface:#0d1424;--raised:#121b2e;--ink:#e6edf3;--muted:#8a98aa;--line:#1f2a3d;--cyan:#00e5ff;--cyan-hi:#6ff2ff;--on-cyan:#070b14;--red:#ff2e63;--field-line:#2f6f86;position:relative;width:100%;min-height:184px;padding:32px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:2px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Rajdhani','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:40px} .ds-reveal::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:10px;pointer-events:none;--b:linear-gradient(var(--cyan),var(--cyan));background:var(--b) top left/16px 2px,var(--b) top left/2px 16px,var(--b) top right/16px 2px,var(--b) top right/2px 16px,var(--b) bottom left/16px 2px,var(--b) bottom left/2px 16px,var(--b) bottom right/16px 2px,var(--b) bottom right/2px 16px;background-repeat:no-repeat;transition:inset .22s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)} .ds-reveal:hover::before{inset:calc(50% - 44px) 8%} .ds-redacted{display:inline-block;height:1em;color:transparent;border-radius:2px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(0,229,255,.34) 0 2px,rgba(0,229,255,.12) 2px 4px);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--cyan)} .ds-hint{font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted)} .ds-drain{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:3px;background:var(--cyan);transform-origin:left;transform:scaleX(0)} .ds-reveal:hover .ds-drain{transform:scaleX(1);animation:ds-drain 5s linear forwards} @keyframes ds-drain{from{transform:scaleX(1)}to{transform:scaleX(0)}} .ds-reveal:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:3px} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-reveal::before{transition:none}.ds-reveal:hover .ds-drain{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
The phone becomes a mission terminal for exactly one secret. The system is the spy-app category standard played straight, at the polish of a competitive shooter's client: a night-navy ground under faint scanlines, hairline panels whose corners are marked by cyan brackets, condensed capitals for anything the player must read at a glance, and a crosshair reticle that opens the app full-size and shrinks to a sigil once the player is inside a room. Two signals carry all meaning: cyan says go, codes and focus; red says host, waiting and danger.

Density is low and the column is narrow (440px at most), built for one phone in one hand in a noisy room. Light is rationed: only the reticle, the home title, the room code and the primary button glow, and everything else is flat hairline on navy. The system peaks in one place, the target box, where holding closes the brackets in, snaps a reticle over the redaction bar, decrypts the name by character scramble and runs a five-second cyan drain.

It refuses the hacker console (code rain, fake command lines, monospace prompts) and the paper dossier (cream sheets, rubber stamps, typewriter labels). The hatched cyan redaction bar is the one device carried forward from the original app.
keyCharacteristics: One dark theme only (color-scheme dark); three navy steps for ground, panel and raised.
Cyan and red are signals with fixed meanings, never decoration.
Rajdhani 600/700 capitals for display, buttons, codes and numbers; Inter for every sentence.
2px corners, 1px hairlines, 16px cyan corner brackets on panels; circles only for reticles.
Motion lives in the lock-on; reduced motion swaps instantly.

rules.name: The Two Signals Rule
rules.body: Cyan means go, codes and focus; red means host, waiting and danger. A color never borrows the other's job, and neither is used as an ornament.

rules.name: The Night Ground Rule
rules.body: There is one theme. Surfaces step up through night, panel and raised navy only; no light mode, no gray cards, no gradients other than the scanlines.

rules.name: The Caps Command, Inter Explains Rule
rules.body: Rajdhani capitals are for things you act on or read at a glance: titles, buttons, codes, counts, tags. Any full sentence is Inter in sentence case.

rules.name: The Wide Code Rule
rules.body: Room codes are always tracked wide (0.32em displayed, 0.45em in the field) so four letters can be read across a room.

rules.name: The Rationed Light Rule
rules.body: Glow appears only on the reticle, the Home title, the room code and the primary button. No panel, card, input or secondary button glows or casts a shadow.

rules.name: The Bracket Rule
rules.body: A panel is marked by its corners, not by a heavier border or a fill change. Brackets are always cyan, 16px by 2px.

dos: **Do** keep cyan for go, codes and focus, and red for host, waiting and danger (The Two Signals Rule).
**Do** set titles, buttons, codes, counts and tags in Rajdhani 700 capitals with positive tracking, and every sentence in Inter.
**Do** give every control at least 48px of height and a 2px cyan focus outline.
**Do** mark panels with 16px cyan corner brackets over a 1px hairline on Panel Navy.
**Do** keep 2px corners on every rectangle and save circles for reticles.
**Do** keep the hatched cyan redaction bar exactly one name-line tall so revealing never shifts the layout.
**Do** honor prefers-reduced-motion with an instant swap and no scramble, snap or drain.
donts: **Don't** add glow beyond the reticle, the Home title, the room code and the primary button lift (The Rationed Light Rule).
**Don't** drift toward a hacker terminal: no code rain, fake command lines or monospace prompts.
**Don't** return to the paper dossier: no cream paper, rubber stamps or typewriter labels.
**Don't** add a light theme or a fourth surface tone.
**Don't** put a small tracked caps line above a heading as decoration; a panel gets a Panel Title only when it has no other heading.
**Don't** round corners past 2px or soften panels with drop shadows.
**Don't** let decoration slow joining: the name field, the code field and Join stay in the first viewport.
